messages:
mira: Ok team — proposed cut for the Py/TS SDK canary today at 16:30 UTC to Cohort A (10% of traffic). I'll push the canary tag and follow with staged npm/pypi publishes. Pinback enabled for legacy sync clients. Release notes draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/3.1-canary-draft - please review.
deploy-bot: [16:31] npm: @redwood/sdk-js v3.1.0-canary published -> dist-tag "cohort-a" :rocket:
sam: thanks. quick q — pinback how aggressive? full pin of sync client deps or just devex consumers? want to avoid breaking customers on locked monorepos.
mira: Pinback = publish deprecated compatibility shim under @redwood/sdk-compat@3.0.x and patch internal manifests to prefer compat when consumers have exact-locks. Not rewiring semver ranges. Only opt-in for cohort A via routing flag.
jordan: FYI last time we saw a signer mismatch during publish step. Can we add checksum scan + signed-tag check in the publish job? If the registry TTL kicks in we can get inconsistent installs.
dave: Change window reminder: security/infra change window closes at 18:00 UTC. Any risky rollout beyond that needs ops approval. Keep canary to non-critical customers and telemetry on.
mira: Good call. Telemetry toggles: verbose logging on for canary; sampling 100% for auth failures, 10% for normal traces. Rollback criteria I propose: 
- sustained error rate +2% absolute over baseline for 10m OR 
- auth/token failures >0.5% of requests over 5m OR 
- >3 unique customers report install/compat break within 30m.
ben: Those are reasonable. Add a manual abort if we see the packaging checksum alert from jordan's scan. Also, what about downtime SLA — we should maintain zero user-facing downtime via fallback to v3.0.4.
erin: I'll add a short migration snippet for the deprecation note so folks can update from sync->async clients. Suggest this example in the notes:
```python
# old sync usage
client = RedwoodClient(sync=True)
# new async usage
async with RedwoodClient() as client:
    await client.complete(prompt)
```
And a TS example too.
mira: Perfect. Ben, can you craft the deprecation blurb? Keep it soft: warn about planned removal in 6 months, provide compat shim link, and steps to pin older runtime if needed.
deploy-bot: [16:42] pypi: redwood-sdk v3.1.0rc1 uploaded -> cohort-a tag
jordan: checksum scan ran: one mismatch alert on the wheel signature during pypi push (transient). I retriggered the publish job; please wait for green before widening cohort.
mira: Holding cohort B and full rollout until we confirm checksum clean. Cohort A is live but throttled. If scans fail again we abort and rollback.
deploy-bot: [16:55] COHORT-A: anomaly detected — auth errors spike 0.9% over baseline for 6m. Threshold exceeded. Initiating auto-fallback to pinned v3.0.4 for Cohort A.
mira: Received. Rolling back cohort A and pausing further publishes. Can someone capture a small sample trace and error logs for the 16:48–16:55 window? @sam @jordan
sam: grabbing traces now. attaching short log snippets in #incidents. preliminary looks like token refresh race when older runtime + compat shim both present.
jordan: I see the same in the traces — refresh TTL off by ms from shim. Patching shim to be tolerant should fix. I'll raise PR to compat with a minor version bump.
dave: Confirmed fallback succeeded and routing reverted for cohort A. No SLA breaches reported. Keep rollback blurb in the release notes timeline.
ben: I'll update the release notes: add a note about the canary, the rollback, and the compat shim patch plan + timeline. Draft ready for review in 30m: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/3.1-canary-draft#postmortem
erin: After jordan's PR merges, recommend a re-run of the canary but narrower (5% traffic) and only after the checksum/signed-tag pass. I'll prep the migration snippet in the final notes.
mira: Agreed. Action items: jordan -> PR for compat patch (ETA 45m), sam -> logs + incident snippet, ben -> update release notes, erin -> finalize examples, dave -> approve any out-of-window ops if needed. We'll reconvene in this thread when ready to retry. Thanks all :thumbsup:
